paragraphs.text: Prism is a unique artifact creature type which only appears on tokens representing magical creatures created from transparent glass that refracts light.

Prism debut as a creature type on tokens created by the Diamond Kaleidoscope artifact from Visions . A prism is an artifact creature that can be sacrificed for one mana of any color . Its appearance is that of a muscular humanoid with an avian head created by the light shined off of the artifact.
Prism has yet to receive its own token card as Diamond Kaleidoscope has not been re-printed due to it being on the Reserved List .
